fn ov_is_function(declaration:*RmdDecl)->bool {
    return (*declaration).kind == RMD_D_FUNCTION || (*declaration).kind == RMD_D_EXTERN;
}

fn ov_reserved(name:*u8)->bool {
    var prefix:*u8 = "rmd_ov1_";
    var index:usize = 0usize;
    while prefix[index] != 0u8 {
        if name[index] != prefix[index] { return false; }
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    return true;
}

fn ov_names(stage:*OvStage, function:*OvFunction)->unit {
    var result_key:*RmdName = ov_type_key(stage, (*(*function).syntax).base);
    if (*stage).failed { return; }
    var buffer:*OvText = &(*stage).scratch;
    (*buffer).size = 0usize;
    ov_text(stage, buffer, "rmd_ov1_d");
    ov_part(stage, buffer, (*stage).abi, c_length((*stage).abi));
    ov_text(stage, buffer, "n");
    var name:*RmdName = (*(*function).group).name;
    ov_part(stage, buffer, (*name).text, (*name).size);
    var parameters:*RmdName = (*function).parameters;
    ov_bytes(stage, buffer, (*parameters).text, (*parameters).size);
    ov_text(stage, buffer, "r");
    ov_bytes(stage, buffer, (*result_key).text, (*result_key).size);
    ov_text(stage, buffer, "c");
    var contract:*RmdName = (*function).contract;
    ov_part(stage, buffer, (*contract).text, (*contract).size);
    var native:*RmdName = ov_intern(stage, (*buffer).data, (*buffer).size);
    if native == null(*RmdName) { return; }
    (*function).native_name = (*native).text;
    (*buffer).size = 0usize;
    ov_text(stage, buffer, "$");
    ov_bytes(stage, buffer, (*native).text, (*native).size);
    (*function).internal_name = ov_intern(stage, (*buffer).data, (*buffer).size);
}

fn ov_add_function(stage:*OvStage, group:*OvGlobal, declaration:*RmdDecl)->unit {
    var syntax:*RmdTypeSyntax = ov_function_syntax(stage, declaration);
    if (*stage).failed { return; }
    var parameters:*RmdName = ov_parameters(stage, syntax);
    var contract:*RmdName = null(*RmdName);
    var hooks:*OvHooks = (*stage).hooks;
    if hooks != null(*OvHooks) && (*hooks).contract != null(fn(*OvStage,*RmdDecl,*u8)->*RmdName) {
        var errors:usize = (*(*stage).context).error_count;
        contract = (*hooks).contract(stage, declaration, (*hooks).user);
        if (*(*stage).context).error_count != errors { (*stage).failed = true; }
    } else { contract = ov_intern(stage, "s", 1usize); }
    if (*stage).failed { return; }
    if contract == null(*RmdName) {
        ov_error(stage, &(*declaration).loc, "overload contract callback returned no contract");
        return;
    }
    var function:*OvFunction = rmd_map_get(&(*group).signatures, parameters as usize) as *OvFunction;
    if function != null(*OvFunction) {
        var previous:*RmdDecl = (*function).declaration;
        if !ov_same(stage, (*(*function).syntax).base, (*syntax).base) {
            ov_error(stage, &(*declaration).loc, "overloads cannot differ only by result type");
            return;
        }
        if (*function).contract != contract {
            ov_error(stage, &(*declaration).loc, "matching overload declarations have different contracts");
            return;
        }
        if ((*previous).kind == RMD_D_EXTERN) != ((*declaration).kind == RMD_D_EXTERN) {
            ov_error(stage, &(*declaration).loc, "matching overload declarations use different source and native ABIs");
            return;
        }
        if (*declaration).kind == RMD_D_EXTERN && !c_equal((*previous).link_name, (*declaration).link_name) {
            ov_error(stage, &(*declaration).loc, "matching native overload declarations have different symbols");
            return;
        }
        if (*previous).body != null(*RmdStmt) && (*declaration).body != null(*RmdStmt) {
            ov_error(stage, &(*declaration).loc, "duplicate overload definition");
            return;
        }
        if (*declaration).body != null(*RmdStmt) {
            (*function).declaration = declaration;
            (*function).syntax = syntax;
            (*function).source_import = false;
        }
    } else {
        function = ov_alloc(stage, sizeof(OvFunction), alignof(OvFunction)) as *OvFunction;
        if function == null(*OvFunction) { return; }
        (*function).declaration = declaration;
        (*function).group = group;
        (*function).syntax = syntax;
        (*function).parameters = parameters;
        (*function).contract = contract;
        (*function).source_import = (*declaration).kind == RMD_D_FUNCTION && (*declaration).body == null(*RmdStmt);
        (*function).next = (*group).first;
        (*group).first = function;
        (*group).count = (*group).count + 1usize;
        (*function).all_next = (*stage).first_function;
        (*stage).first_function = function;
        ov_put(stage, &(*group).signatures, parameters as usize, function as *u8);
        ov_names(stage, function);
    }
    ov_put(stage, &(*stage).declarations, declaration as usize, function as *u8);
}

// Require parsed source units and an initialized stage. Call once before resolution.
// Retain original source names and publish complete function signatures.
fn ov_collect(stage:*OvStage)->bool {
    var unit_value:*RmdUnit = (*(*stage).context).units;
    while unit_value != null(*RmdUnit) && !(*stage).failed {
        var declaration:*RmdDecl = (*unit_value).declarations;
        while declaration != null(*RmdDecl) && !(*stage).failed {
            var group:*OvGlobal = ov_global(stage, (*declaration).name);
            if group == null(*OvGlobal) {
                group = ov_alloc(stage, sizeof(OvGlobal), alignof(OvGlobal)) as *OvGlobal;
                if group == null(*OvGlobal) { return false; }
                (*group).name = (*declaration).name;
                (*group).declaration = declaration;
                (*group).next = (*stage).first_global;
                (*stage).first_global = group;
                ov_put(stage, &(*stage).globals, (*group).name as usize, group as *u8);
                var field:*RmdField = (*declaration).fields;
                while field != null(*RmdField) && !(*stage).failed {
                    if rmd_map_get(&(*group).fields, (*field).name as usize) != null(*u8) {
                        ov_error(stage, &(*field).loc, "duplicate record field");
                        return false;
                    }
                    ov_put(stage, &(*group).fields, (*field).name as usize, field as *u8);
                    field = (*field).next;
                }
            } else {
                if !ov_is_function(declaration) || !ov_is_function((*group).declaration) {
                    ov_error(stage, &(*declaration).loc, "duplicate source declaration");
                    return false;
                }
            }
            if ov_is_function(declaration) {
                if (*declaration).kind == RMD_D_EXTERN && ov_reserved((*declaration).link_name) {
                    ov_error(stage, &(*declaration).loc, "native extern uses the reserved overload symbol prefix; use a source import");
                    return false;
                }
                ov_add_function(stage, group, declaration);
            }
            declaration = (*declaration).next;
        }
        unit_value = (*unit_value).next;
    }
    unit_value = (*(*stage).context).units;
    while unit_value != null(*RmdUnit) && !(*stage).failed {
        var declaration:*RmdDecl = (*unit_value).declarations;
        while declaration != null(*RmdDecl) && !(*stage).failed {
            var names:RmdMap = make RmdMap { entries:null(*RmdMapEntry), count:0usize, capacity:0usize };
            var parameter:*RmdParam = (*declaration).params;
            while parameter != null(*RmdParam) && !(*stage).failed {
                if ov_global(stage, (*parameter).name) != null(*OvGlobal) ||
                   rmd_map_get(&names, (*parameter).name as usize) != null(*u8) {
                    ov_error(stage, &(*parameter).loc, "parameter shadows a visible source name");
                    return false;
                }
                ov_put(stage, &names, (*parameter).name as usize, parameter as *u8);
                parameter = (*parameter).next;
            }
            declaration = (*declaration).next;
        }
        unit_value = (*unit_value).next;
    }
    return !(*stage).failed;
}

// Require successful collection and resolution. Publish unique seed names once.
// Preserve explicit native symbols. Source imports use generated source ABI symbols.
fn ov_mangle(stage:*OvStage)->bool {
    if (*stage).failed { return false; }
    var unit_value:*RmdUnit = (*(*stage).context).units;
    while unit_value != null(*RmdUnit) {
        var cursor:**RmdDecl = &(*unit_value).declarations;
        while *cursor != null(*RmdDecl) {
            var declaration:*RmdDecl = *cursor;
            if ov_is_function(declaration) {
                var function:*OvFunction = rmd_map_get(&(*stage).declarations, declaration as usize) as *OvFunction;
                if (*function).declaration != declaration {
                    *cursor = (*declaration).next;
                    continue;
                }
                (*declaration).name = (*function).internal_name;
                if (*declaration).kind == RMD_D_FUNCTION { (*declaration).link_name = (*function).native_name; }
                if (*function).source_import { (*declaration).kind = RMD_D_EXTERN; }
            }
            cursor = &(*declaration).next;
        }
        unit_value = (*unit_value).next;
    }
    return true;
}

fn ov_prepare(stage:*OvStage)->bool {
    return ov_collect(stage) && ov_resolve(stage) && ov_mangle(stage);
}
